newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: One killed, 16 injured in Philippine grenade blasts.
newsitem.headline: One killed, 16 injured in Philippine grenade blasts.

text.p: A 73-year-old woman was killed and 16 people injured when two grenades exploded after being lobbed into a market early on Saturday in M'lang town in the southern Philippines, the town's mayor said.
The victims were shopping when hit by the blasts, mayor Emmanuel Pinol told reporters.

"Initial investigations showed this could be the handiwork of the people we are hunting" in connection with the kidnapping of a trader, Pinol told radio station DZND in nearby Kidipawan town in Cotabato province.
Residents of M'lang, about 1,200 km (700 miles) from Manila, are set to hold a rally on Sunday to protest at the wealthy trader's kidnapping on March 24.
The kidnappers have demanded a ransom for the trader's release, Pinol said.
He said police were questioning three men seen fleeing after the blasts.
